video_directives: Scene-to-scene tempo is solid (~2-3s beats, no dead holds); keep the mid-scene camera push-ins but add one micro-beat more per card so diagram panels don't outstay their read.

Main character reads alive (pose shifts, walking, pointing, reactions at purge beat) — but secondary crowd characters are near-static cutouts between poses; add subtle idle sway/blink loops to everyone on screen.

Transitions breathe well (fade/zoom eases, sky color shifts to red are motivated), but the cut from fridge-door assembly back to crowd-shields could carry motion continuity — match the door-slam gesture across the cut.
